mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_service_question (question_hash, question, normalized_question, source_type, use_count, last_user_id, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{questionHash}, #{question}, #{normalizedQuestion}, 'service', 1, #{lastUserId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE use_count = IF(use_count < 2147483647, use_count + 1, use_count), last_user_id = VALUES(last_user_id), last_used_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, question_hash, question, normalized_question, source_type, use_count, last_user_id, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at, enabled, review_status, admin_remark FROM ai_service_question WHERE source_type = 'service' AND enabled = 1 AND review_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY use_count DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT content FROM ai_chat_memory WHERE type = 'USER' AND conversation_id LIKE 'service:%' AND content IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(content)) > 0 ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_service_question_log (user_id, question, matched_question, similarity, matched, created_at) VALUES (#{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{question}, #{matchedQuestion,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{similarity,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{matched}, NOW())
